title: Laravel Declaration manifest
description: The YAML file at `laravel-declaration.manifest` (default `manifest/app.yml`). See README.md#manifest.

classString.description: A fully-qualified class name. Write it plain or single-quoted; double quotes make `\` an escape.

reference.description: A PHP reference: an invokable FQCN, `Class@method`, `Class::method` (static) or a namespaced function. There is no array form.

phpFile.description: A `.php` file, required once per process; its return value is used. Relative paths resolve under basePath(); one starting with `/` or `\` is used as-is.

closure.description: A PHP reference, or a `.php` file returning a Closure.

concrete.description: A class-string or another bound abstract (not `Class@method`), `~` for a self-binding, or a `.php` file returning a Closure called as ($app, $parameters).

binding.description: A map is one call per `abstract: concrete` entry; a list is one call per item, each self-binding (a `.php` item binds under its Closure's return types).

bindingIf.description: Like the unconditional form, but skipped when the abstract is already bound (deferred services included). A `.php` list item throws; use the map form.

config.description: The argument to config([...]): every `<file>.<key>` path is a config() key. A key may be a dot-path; a map value replaces that node whole. Declare literals, not env(...) expressions.

additionalProperties.description: A config file key (e.g. `app` is ./config/app.php). A scalar here throws LogicException.

app.description: Illuminate\Foundation\Application methods: every key is a method name, its value the argument(s). Applied in a fixed order, not document order. An unknown key throws LogicException.

bindIf.description: -> bindIf(); skipped when bound, deferred services included

instance.description: -> instance($abstract, $instance). A class- or interface-string is make()d eagerly, a `.php` file binds its return value (any type), anything else binds as YAML decoded it.

extend.description: -> extend($abstract, Closure); parameters `$instance` and `$app` match by name

registered.description: -> registered(); fires right after the block, receives $app

terminating.description: -> terminating(); after the response, injected by type-hint only

router.description: Illuminate\Routing\Router methods: every key is a method name, its value the argument(s). Applied first in boot(), before `providers` and `routes`. An unknown key throws LogicException.

pattern.description: -> pattern($key, $pattern), one call per entry: a global `where`, merged into every route created afterwards (URI and domain parameters). A route's own `where` wins. Single-quote the regex: `[` starts a YAML list.

model.description: -> model($key, $class), one call per entry: {key} resolves through $class::resolveRouteBinding($value) in SubstituteBindings (`web`/`api` groups), on every route. 404 when null; a route's `missing` handles it. Ignores {key:field} and scopeBindings.

bind.description: -> bind($key, $binder), one call per entry: `Class` (method `bind`) or `Class@method`, make()d and called ($value, $route) in SubstituteBindings. Not an invokable, not `Class::method`.

middlewareGroup.description: -> middlewareGroup($name, $middleware): Defines/replaces a route middleware group on the router. Items are middleware class-strings, aliases, or `alias:params` forms; resolved at dispatch. A `kernel:` middleware key wins when both blocks declare the same group.

aliasMiddleware.description: -> aliasMiddleware($name, $class): Registers a route middleware alias on the router, usable in any route's `middleware` list (with an optional `:params` suffix).

prependMiddlewareToGroup.description: -> prependMiddlewareToGroup($group, $middleware): One call per item, reversed so declared order lands at the group head. Silent no-op when the group is missing.

pushMiddlewareToGroup.description: -> pushMiddlewareToGroup($group, $middleware): One call per item; appends to the group, creating it when missing. No-op when already present.

removeMiddlewareFromGroup.description: -> removeMiddlewareFromGroup($group, $middleware): One call per item; removes the middleware from the group. Silent no-op when the group or the middleware is missing. The only remove seam in Laravel (the kernel has none).

singularResourceParameters.description: -> singularResourceParameters($singular): false pluralizes resource parameter names globally ({posts}). Absent: Laravel's default (true). Baked into route:cache.

resourceParameters.description: -> resourceParameters($parameters): One call with the whole map; replaces the global resource parameter map ({resource: paramName}). Baked into route:cache.

resourceVerbs.description: -> resourceVerbs($verbs): One call with the whole map; array_merges the resource verbs (create/edit) used in resource URIs. Baked into route:cache.

matched.description: -> matched($callback): One call per item; registers a RouteMatched listener (fires at dispatch, before route middleware). `Class` (method `handle`, bare invokables fall back to `__invoke`) or `Class@method`, called with ($event).

view.description: Illuminate\View\Factory methods: every key is a method name, its value the argument(s). Applied when Laravel first resolves `view` (callAfterResolving, queued in boot()). An unknown key throws LogicException.

addLocation.description: -> addLocation($location), one call per item: searched after config('view.paths'). A relative path resolves under basePath().

prependLocation.description: -> prependLocation($location), one call per item: searched before every other location. A relative path resolves under basePath().

addNamespace.description: -> addNamespace($namespace, $hints), one call per entry: `namespace::view` searches these paths after the hints already registered.

prependNamespace.description: -> prependNamespace($namespace, $hints), one call per entry: searched before the hints already registered, so it overrides a package's views.

replaceNamespace.description: -> replaceNamespace($namespace, $hints), one call per entry: discards the hints already registered. Laravel replaces `errors` and `mail` itself at render.

addExtension.description: -> addExtension($extension, $engine), one call per entry: `.$extension` files render with $engine (blade, php, file) and are found before every other extension.

share.description: -> share($key) with the whole map: every entry reaches every view as YAML decoded it. View data, creators and composers override it. Never share `__env` or `app`.

composer.description: -> composer($views, $callback), key is view name or comma-separated list of views, value is callback/class.

creator.description: -> creator($views, $callback), key is view name or comma-separated list of views, value is callback/class.

flushFinderCache.description: -> flushFinderCache(): true empties the finder's resolved-view cache after the block applies, so declared locations, namespaces and extensions win over finds cached before the provider booted.

flushState.description: -> flushState(): true resets renderCount, renderedOnce, sections, stacks, components and fragments after the block applies (worker and test isolation).

kernel.description: HTTP Kernel configuration mapped 1:1 onto Illuminate\Foundation\Http\Kernel methods.

pushMiddleware.description: -> pushMiddleware($middleware): Appends to the global middleware stack.

prependMiddleware.description: -> prependMiddleware($middleware): Prepends to the global middleware stack.

setGlobalMiddleware.description: -> setGlobalMiddleware($middleware): Replaces the global middleware stack.

appendMiddlewareToGroup.description: -> appendMiddlewareToGroup($group, $middleware): Appends to a route middleware group.

prependMiddlewareToGroup.description: -> prependMiddlewareToGroup($group, $middleware): Prepends to a route middleware group.

setMiddlewareGroups.description: -> setMiddlewareGroups($groups): Replaces all route middleware groups.

setMiddlewareAliases.description: -> setMiddlewareAliases($aliases): Defines or overrides middleware aliases.

setMiddlewarePriority.description: -> setMiddlewarePriority($priority): Replaces the priority order of route middleware.

prependToMiddlewarePriority.description: -> prependToMiddlewarePriority($middleware): Prepends to middleware priority list.

appendToMiddlewarePriority.description: -> appendToMiddlewarePriority($middleware): Appends to middleware priority list.

addToMiddlewarePriorityBefore.description: -> addToMiddlewarePriorityBefore($before, $middleware): Inserts middleware before target anchor.

addToMiddlewarePriorityAfter.description: -> addToMiddlewarePriorityAfter($after, $middleware): Inserts middleware after target anchor.

routes.description: A map of Illuminate\Routing\Router registration method names (Design Rule 1: key = method name); each list item is one call. addRoute/view/redirect/permanentRedirect return a Route (optional builders ride it); resource/apiResource/singleton/apiSingleton return a Pending*Registration (options dispatch onto its fluent methods); group mutates the group stack and recurses into nested routes. Batch forms are not given keys: one call per singular entry covers them (Rule 2).

routeGroup.description: Router::group($attributes, Closure) attributes — exactly the eight RouteGroup::merge() attributes; every nested declaration rides the reserved routes key (recursive). Prefix/as/namespace concatenate, where/middleware/metadata merge, domain/controller replace.

routeResource.description: Router::resource/apiResource/singleton/apiSingleton($name, $controller): one RESTful controller per entry. Every options key is one PendingResourceRegistration / PendingSingletonResourceRegistration fluent method call (only, except, names, name, parameters, parameter, middleware, middlewareFor, withoutMiddleware, withoutMiddlewareFor, where, metadata, shallow, missing, scoped, withTrashed, creatable, destroyable, whereNumber/whereAlpha/whereAlphaNumeric/whereUuid/whereUlid/whereIn); unknown options fail at boot with BadMethodCallException.

routeView.description: Router::view($uri, $view, $data, $status, $headers): GET|HEAD ViewController shortcut. Any other key is a Route builder on the returned route (open shape; unknown builders fail at boot with BadMethodCallException).

routeRedirect.description: Router::redirect($uri, $destination, $status): all-seven-verbs RedirectController shortcut; the URI may carry parameters the destination reuses. Any other key is a Route builder on the returned route.

routePermanentRedirect.description: Router::permanentRedirect($uri, $destination): a 301 redirect. No status argument exists natively — declare a status under a redirect entry instead. Any other key is a Route builder on the returned route.

authorize.description: FormRequest::authorize(): bool|Response. A boolean passes through; a string is a PHP reference resolved via Container::call; a map declares one native Gate call — the key is the Illuminate\Contracts\Auth\Access\Gate method name (check, any, none, allows, denies, inspect, authorize, raw) and the value is a map of that method's native parameter names (ability|abilities, arguments). `arguments` follows Authorize::getGateArguments(): a class-string passes through, a route parameter name resolves to its bound value, a quoted literal unquotes.

validator.description: Illuminate\Validation\Factory registry methods: every key is a method name, its value the registry content. Applied when Laravel first resolves `validator` (callAfterResolving, queued in boot()). An unknown key throws no error (DataModel drops it) but fails this schema.

extend.description: -> extend($rule, $extension, $message = null), one call per entry: the key is the rule name, the value the extension reference string or a map of the native parameter names {extension, message}.

extendImplicit.description: -> extendImplicit($rule, $extension, $message = null): the rule runs even when the field is absent or empty.

extendDependent.description: -> extendDependent($rule, $extension, $message = null): the parsed rule lands in dependentRules, so its parameters may reference other fields.

replacer.description: -> replacer($rule, $replacer), one call per entry: the value replaces message placeholders; a bare class-string resolves to its `replace` method.

gate.description: Illuminate\Contracts\Auth\Access\Gate registry methods: every key is a method name, its value the registry content — one call per entry. Applied when the Gate first resolves (callAfterResolving).

policy.description: ≈ Gate::policy($class, $policy), one call per entry: the key is the model class-string, the value the policy class-string.

define.description: ≈ Gate::define($ability, $callback), one call per entry: the key is the ability name, the value the 'Class@method' or invokable class-string reference, passed through untouched.

model.description: Every key except the reserved `class` is an Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model property, assigned before Laravel initializes the model as if written in the class body, or a Model method. An unknown key fails this schema (authoring-time guard) and is ignored at runtime.

class.description: Reserved: the DeclaredModel subclass, spelled as static::class spells it (no leading `\`).

connection.description: -> $connection (#[Connection]): a database.connections name. Absent: the default connection.

table.description: -> $table (#[Table(name)]). Absent: the snake-case plural of the class basename.

timestamps.description: -> $timestamps (#[WithoutTimestamps]). Absent: true. false also makes other models skip touching this one.

dateFormat.description: -> $dateFormat (#[DateFormat]): how date columns are stored. Absent: the connection grammar's format.

attributes.description: -> $attributes: raw, storable default values of a new model.

casts.description: -> $casts: attribute => cast string (boolean, array, datetime:Y-m-d, encrypted:array, an enum, a cast class, Class:arg). A casts() method in the class is merged over it.

hidden.description: -> $hidden (#[Hidden]): left out of toArray() and toJson().

visible.description: -> $visible (#[Visible]): when non-empty, the only attributes in toArray() and toJson().

appends.description: -> $appends (#[Appends]): accessors added to toArray() and toJson(). The accessor is a method in the class.

with.description: -> $with: relations eager loaded by every query. The relation is a method in the class.

withCount.description: -> $withCount: relation counts ({relation}_count) loaded by every query.

touches.description: -> $touches (#[Touches]): relations whose updated_at is touched when this model saves.

refreshes.description: -> $refreshes (#[Refreshes]): columns re-read from the database after each save.

dispatchesEvents.description: -> $dispatchesEvents: model event => event class, dispatched as new $class($model).

observables.description: -> $observables: custom event names an observer method may handle.

observe.description: -> observe($classes) when the model boots, where Laravel applies #[ObservedBy]: one listener per observer method named after an observable event.

addGlobalScope.description: -> addGlobalScope($scope), one call per item when the model boots, where Laravel applies #[ScopedBy]: an Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Scope class.

getRouteKeyName.description: -> getRouteKeyName() (#[RouteKey]): the column router.model and route() use. Absent: the primary key.

schema.description: Declarative database schema definition. Verb keys are native Illuminate\Database\Schema\Builder method names.

connection.description: The database connection name. If omitted or null, the default connection is used.

create.description: Builder::create($table, $callback) — one guarded call per entry; body = Blueprint methods.

table.description: Builder::table($table, $callback) — alter blueprint; every action is dispatched through its derived native guard.

drop.description: Builder::drop($table) — one call per entry (unguarded: fails loudly if the table is missing).

tableDefinition.description: Declarative table schema definition containing Blueprint column methods, indexes, and table options.
